name: Jest of the Revitalizing Gale
body:
School: conjuration (healing); Level: jester 7

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: personal

Target: you

Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Any healing effects applied to you will have their healing amount doubled until the end of your next turn.
